import numpy as np

# Get the pose and extent of the brown spill
spill_pose, spill_quat, bbox_extent = get_object_pose('brown spill', return_bbox_extent=True)

# Extract the center of the spill for the wiping motion
spill_center = spill_pose

# Define the downward-facing orientation (0, 0, 1, 0) wxyz
downward_quat = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0])

# Cover the spill area at the table surface (z=0.0)
min_x = spill_center[0] - bbox_extent[0] / 2
max_x = spill_center[0] + bbox_extent[0] / 2
min_y = spill_center[1] - bbox_extent[1] / 2
max_y = spill_center[1] + bbox_extent[1] / 2

for y in np.linspace(min_y, max_y, 10):
    for x in np.linspace(min_x, max_x, 10):
        goto_pose(np.array([x, y, 0.0]), downward_quat)
